name: Data Mover: Live deployment diagnostics on Posit Connect
summary: Give Posit Connect administrators a way to check saved live connections, verify synthetic transfers, and share a sanitized support report.
description: Add an Admin → Diagnostics page that runs inside Posit Connect using the initiating administrator's saved credentials. Provide read-only checks, a verified smoke transfer, and a full suite for supported routes and write modes. Use approved synthetic fixtures and scratch targets for writes. Persist progress, verification, and cleanup results so administrators can reopen a run and copy a report for developers.
desired_expected_result: An authorized administrator can run connection checks, a verified smoke transfer, and the configured full matrix using owned credentials and approved scratch targets. The suite survives restarts and avoids duplicate writes. Results distinguish readiness, verification, cleanup, and reconciliation. The support report excludes restricted fields and correlates to internal run evidence.

name: Data Mover: Admin access and live connection checks
description:
As an administrator, I want to check my saved connections from Posit Connect so I can distinguish deployment, credential, and provider problems.

Rollout: 1 · Connection checks
Dependencies: None
desired_expected_result:
- Non-admins and other administrators cannot access a suite or invoke an action. Links work under a Connect mount prefix.
- Spool checks use an isolated file and remove it. The export contains no credentials, database URL, or filesystem paths.
- Configured, missing, disabled, authentication-failed, and compute-not-ready cases show distinct outcomes. Read-only checks perform no provider writes or compute starts.
- The administrator can leave and reopen the page and inspect the result of each selected check.

name: Data Mover: Durable diagnostic execution
description:
As an administrator, I want suites to survive refreshes and restarts so I can return to an accurate result and avoid duplicate transfers.

Rollout: 1–2 · Connection and transfer checks
Dependencies: None
desired_expected_result:
- Migration preserves ordinary pipelines. Diagnostic definitions are identifiable and hidden from ordinary saved routes.
- Multiple app processes enforce one active suite and one active diagnostic transfer per suite. Waiting for a child does not consume a transfer slot.
- A duplicate request or crash at the enqueue boundary results in at most one child. Existing pipeline policy and worker leases apply.
- An ambiguous publication retains evidence, keeps the affected target blocked, and never triggers an automatic duplicate write.
- Cleanup and publication obligations remain visible and recoverable past the normal expiry date.

name: Data Mover: Approve and isolate scratch resources
description:

Rollout: 2 · Verified smoke transfer
Dependencies: LD-2
desired_expected_result:

- Rotation, deletion, or role revocation prevents new affected work, requests safe cancellation of active work, and keeps unresolved resources recorded.
- The server binds the accepted preview to its validated inputs and detects stale selections before dispatch.
- Cleanup removes only tracked targets with confirmed identity. Uncertain and manual cleanup have explicit statuses and recovery instructions.

name: Data Mover: Run and verify the CSV to PostgreSQL smoke transfer

- The evidence distinguishes live operator observations from isolated recovery evidence and links to the relevant support references.

name: Data Mover: Expand route and write mode coverage
description:
As an administrator, I want to exercise each available direction and write policy so I can isolate provider-specific incompatibilities.

Rollout: 3 · Full coverage
Dependencies: LD-5
desired_expected_result:
- CSV has no destination cells. Same-provider cases use distinct objects. Disabled, missing, and unsupported combinations remain visible with reasons.
- Each mode has a distinct expected destination state that detects wrong content, duplicates, or unchanged rows.
- Replacement preserves a sibling fixture file. Creation follows existing writer and credential checks. Undeletable objects show manual cleanup.
- Metadata, writer, and startup gates remain authoritative. Existing compute and publication paths supply readiness and reconciliation evidence.
- A bad fixture, stale schema, missing permission, or disabled writer is localized to the affected scenarios before writes.

name: Data Mover: Verify data integrity and guardrail behavior

- Expected blocks pass only with the right reason and unchanged destination. Allowed runs confirm the expected transformed output without reporting raw values.
- The result proves whether the boundary was reached and captures the resulting destination impact and cleanup.
